note: Hashes freeze the exact historical result bytes without duplicating them. New experiments write seed-level raw files and must not overwrite these files. The files map holds raw-byte hashes as recorded on Windows (CRLF) and is kept as the historical record; it is NOT portable, because git checks the same blob out with CRLF on Windows and LF on Linux. files_sha256_lf holds line-ending-normalized hashes of the same content and is the check enforced by tests/test_baseline_manifest.py, which passes on every platform.
